issue_request: FHIR-5874 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU1 and asked that hierarchy view display the data type of an inline extension rather than showing every profiled extension as generic Extension.
initial_application: The Jira-recorded svn revision 4557 maps to imported git-svn commit 7996f50897b97db120319141c23e9a1070d853b4. That commit changed the old in-repository Java ProfileUtilities renderer to resolve a profiled extension, find its Extension.value definition, and render that value type in hierarchy rows.
additional_context: The old Java publisher source edited by revision 4557 is no longer present in the current FHIR core checkout. Current build-scoped profile source correctly declares extension slices as Extension with profile URLs, and the current build output shows the renderer interpreting those definitions for display. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The published audit records that current rendered hierarchy behavior satisfies the historical request and that there is no current core source patch to make.
